automatic_20_seconds.en: We turn one A2A task into A2A Interaction Intelligence Trace or Risk Reports: 6 credits each, floor 5. Catalog, health, schemas, samples and quotes are free. Agents call the API directly. Self-reports stay self-reports. No global reputation or payment verification.
